column1: # Accepted findings on corpus-public/. The files are third-party teaching material, not defect-free by
# construction, so a row here records a finding that is either a real defect in the upstream file (say so)
# or a false positive judged not worth changing the rule for. "*" in place of file:line accepts every
# finding of that rule. RuleEvaluationReportTest fails on a finding missing from this file and on a row
# A reason that opens "rule limit:" marks a finding the rule should not have made, and so a candidate
# rule fix. Nothing in this folder may be edited: it is checked in byte-for-byte from upstream.

rule limit: every one of the 11 findings is the priming-read loop the course teaches -- PERFORM READ-RECORD, then PERFORM UNTIL LASTREC = 'Y' with PERFORM READ-RECORD in the body -- where READ-RECORD sets LASTREC in its AT END phrase; R012 takes the loop body to be the nodes the loop header dominates, and READ-RECORD is also performed from before the loop, so the update is invisible to it.

rule limit: the same MOVE ZERO into EMP-REWARD at line 45 leaves the monthly product unbounded, and an unbounded interval reaches below zero.
